tr.description:
Solo is the ultimate practice App for mastering fretboard visualization, designed by world renowned guitarists Tom Quayle and David Beebee.

Four powerful fretboard trainers allow you to work intuitively on each aspect of the visualization process; learning note names, memorising interval shapes, outlining chord changes, and practicing scales.

Solo asks you to find intervallic functions against one root note, chord symbol or scale at a time, listens to the notes you play, and doesn’t move on until you’ve correctly found each note by its intervallic function in the specified order.

Practice with Solo and finally learn your note names, master interval shapes, confidently play through chord changes and break out of scale boxes with intervallic functions. Start transforming your playing and confidence on the fretboard today!


NOTE TRAINER
The Note Trainer is perfect for beginner and intermediate players getting to grips with note names on the neck - the foundation of solid fretboard knowledge. 

‣ Solo shows you random root notes to find and listens, waiting for you to get it correct.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Optional practice suggestions offer challenging ways to limit and test yourself.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


INTERVAL TRAINER
The Interval Trainer will help players at all levels work on interval shapes with intervallic functions - the key to unlocking true freedom on the fretboard.

‣ Choose any combination of intervallic functions to practice.
‣ Create custom interval groups or choose the intervals for ANY chord type or scale.
‣ The Interval Trainer will randomise your chosen intervals and ask you to find them against either a fixed or random root note.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams, showing you where all of the interval shapes are across the neck, and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


CHANGES TRAINER
In the Changes Trainer you find intervallic functions, using single notes to outline different chord types or sets of chord changes, a key skill for learning to improvise through chord changes.  

‣ Practice outlining intervallic functions through over 100 common chord progressions and single chord exercises.
‣ 50 intervallic function levels. Go from simple chord tones to complex melodic structures and scales. 
‣ Solo intelligently maps out the correct intervals over each chord and listens for you to play each intervallic function in the specified order.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Transpose the key of any progression or exercise. 
‣ Choose to randomly transpose the progression (or single chord exercise) each time it repeats.
‣ Work on voice leading chord tones through single note lines.


SCALE TRAINER
The Scale Trainer contains a vast array of scales and powerful workout options, allowing you to finally break out of the box and develop a much deeper understanding of how scales are constructed on the fretboard.

‣ Practice finding scales on the fretboard using intervallic functions. 
‣ Over 50+ Scales and modes.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Melodic sequence options let you focus on starting from any chord tone within the scale.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.

tr.description:
Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997! Build your roster from the iconic cast of 30 characters stacked with charming personalities and witty banter, and get the edge on the competition with power-ups, fireball pitches, super strength, and Pablo Sanchez!
Play pick-up games, practice batting, and compete in single games or a whole season with simple, intuitive controls that anyone can master!
Game Modes:
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself, and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer to choose players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You create a team and manage it through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At the end of the season the best two teams advance to the BBL playoffs (best of 3). The winner advances to the championship series which consists of the Super Entire Nation Tournament (best of 3) and then the Ultra Grand Championship of the Universe Series (best of 5)!
Batting Practice: Choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit that ball!
T-ball - Select T-ball mode for more accessible game play. Simply click to hit, run, and field!
 
BACKYARD BASEBALL RULES
The rules for Backyard Baseball are a hybrid of Pro and Little League rules:
No leading off
No Injuries
Bunting is allowed
Tagging up is allowed
Stealing is allowed
 
At our core, we are fans first–not just of video games but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. Backyard Baseball '97 runs buttery smooth for iOS devices, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the title that started it all.

tr.description:
Just Press Record is the ultimate audio recorder bringing one tap recording, transcription and iCloud syncing to all your devices. You can edit your audio and transcriptions right inside the app and even start a new recording completely hands-free with Siri!

Life is full of moments we would rather not forget - like your child’s first words, an important meeting or spontaneous idea. Capture these moments effortlessly on iPhone, iPad, Mac or for ultimate convenience, Apple Watch.

RECORD
• One tap to start, stop, pause and resume recording.
• Start and stop recording from the Lock Screen, Control Centre, the Action Button, Shortcuts, Siri, the Widget, a 3D Touch Quick Action or via the URL scheme.
• Unlimited recording time.
• Record discretely in the background.
• Choose to record from the built-in mic, AirPods or external microphones.
• Record independently on Apple Watch and sync later.

PLAY
• Seek backwards and forwards during playback.
• Adjustable playback speed.

TRANSCRIBE
• Turn speech into searchable text.
• Support for over 30 languages, independent of your device's language setting.
• Synchronized text highlighting and audio playback.
• Format as you record with punctuation commands.

EDIT
• Audio - visualise your audio in the waveform view and cut out the parts you don’t need.
• Text - make corrections and add new text to your transcriptions.

SHARE
• Share audio and text to other apps.
• Share easily to social media as a video clip.
• Share to iTunes on Mac or PC via USB cable.
• Print a hard copy of your transcripts.
• Share audio files from other apps to Just Press Record. 

ORGANISATION
• View recent recordings or browse your library by date and time.
• Search by filename or transcription content.
• Dedicated tab for quick access to recordings made on Apple Watch.
• Rename recordings.
• Slide Over and Split View support on iPad.
• Add a badge to the app icon showing the number of unplayed recordings.

STORAGE
• Choose to store recordings in iCloud Drive or locally on-device.
• Recordings stored in iCloud Drive automatically sync across all your devices.
• Recordings stored locally benefit from Files app integration and automatic iTunes File Sharing.
• Transcriptions are stored within the audio file.

PRO-AUDIO
• Support for stereo recording from the built-in microphone on supported devices.
• Support for high quality external microphones connected via the Lightning Port.
• Customisable Audio Settings to enhance your recording experience.
• File types include WAV, AIF or standard iTunes M4A (ACC).
• High quality audio up to 96kHz / 24-bit.

ACCESSIBILITY
• VoiceOver support throughout the app.
• Magic Tap gesture to start / stop a recording.

APPLE WATCH
Just Press Record includes an Apple Watch app that gives you the freedom to record anywhere, even when your iPhone is not around.

• Start recording with a single tap on the Complication.
• Record discretely in the background.
• Unlimited recording time.
• Recordings automatically transfer to iPhone for transcription and iCloud syncing.
• Listen to recent recordings through the built-in speaker or AirPods.
• Adjust volume with the Digital Crown.
• Pause recording with a downward swipe.
• Accessibility support with VoiceOver, reduced motion and support for the extra large Complication template.

IMPORTANT:
• Just Press Record does not record phone calls or audio from other apps.
• Transcription requires a good, clean audio signal.  Avoid recording in noisy environments and ensure the microphone is positioned close to the source.
• URL scheme implemented by Just Press Record can be found on our FAQ page.

tr.releaseNotes:
NEW IN 7.2
• Keep screen awake now has three choices in Settings: Off, While Studying and Always. While Studying keeps the screen on while you read an algorithm, study flashcards or practice, and lets it dim as usual everywhere else. If you had the switch on, it is now Always.
• Bracketed groups such as (R U R') now stay on one line in the quizzes, on flashcards and in the algorithm editor, instead of breaking across two lines.

IN CASE YOU MISSED 7.1
• Cube CFOP now speaks Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese and German. Choose in Settings > Language; the app switches right away. Case names and notation stay as cubers write them.
• 2-Sided PLL Quiz: name the PLL case from the top and the two sides you see, as on the cube in your hands.
• Random Front Color: a new PLL quiz option beside Random AUF, so a case comes in every color. Both start off, and each quiz remembers your choice.
• OLL, PLL and 2-Sided PLL quizzes now ask every case once before any comes again. A case you miss or skip returns a few cases later.
• Copy Algorithm: copy any algorithm from its menu, ready to paste into a timer or a note.
• You can now delete the last algorithm of a side angle. Front always keeps one.
• OLL 2-Look step one now names its cases L-shape, Line and Dot instead of 1-1, 1-2 and 1-3.

IN CASE YOU MISSED 7.0.1
• OLL and PLL cases have four viewing angles: Front, Right, Back and Left. Each is drawn and played in 3D from that side and holds the algorithms you write for it. On a side angle, Create from Front writes its algorithm from your Front one.

IN CASE YOU MISSED 7.0
Cube CFOP 7.0 is rebuilt from the ground up, with new ways to learn and practice every case.

• Learning: a new tab with four-grade flashcards (Again, Hard, Good, Easy), daily review, and a report of your streak and study days.
• Practice: OLL and PLL Recognition Quizzes, the F2L Corner Quiz, and a timed Execution Drill.
• Algorithms: watch any algorithm on a 3D cube, add your own alias and note, and search every case. The editor checks that an algorithm solves its case.
• Guides: the CFOP method from Overview to PLL, an Example Solve on the 3D cube, Finger Patterns, and a redrawn Notation guide.
• Also: your cube's colors and grip, Light and Dark appearance, iPhone Duo and iPad two-column layouts, keyboard shortcuts, and a new app icon.
• No usage analytics. The app sends crash reports only.

Your favorites, edited algorithms and flashcard progress carry over. Your algorithm lists stay as they were; to take the new recommended algorithms, use Settings > Restore Default Algorithms.
tr.description:
Learn CFOP, the most popular speedcubing method, one case at a time. Every F2L, OLL and PLL algorithm, with flashcards, quizzes and a timed drill to make them stick.

EVERY CASE OF CFOP
• 41 F2L, 57 OLL and 21 PLL cases, plus 2-Look OLL and 2-Look PLL to get you started.
• Alternative algorithms for many cases: pick the one that suits your hands, or write your own. The editor checks that it solves the case.
• Watch any algorithm on a 3D cube, and tap a move to play up to it.
• See any F2L, OLL or PLL case from each of its four angles, and write the algorithm for that angle, or create it from your Front one.
• Setup moves for each case, and room for your own alias and note.
• Search by name, alias, group or note.

LEARN WITH FLASHCARDS
• Add the cases you are working on to Learning.
• Spaced repetition brings each card back when it is due. Grade it Again, Hard, Good or Easy.
• Practice your hard, new or random cards whenever you like.
• Report: a heat map of your study days, your streak, and what is due in the next 7 days.

PRACTICE UNTIL IT IS AUTOMATIC
• OLL and PLL Recognition Quizzes: name the case from its pattern, against the clock.
• 2-Sided PLL Quiz: name the PLL case from the top and the two sides you see, as on the cube in your hands.
• Random AUF and Random Front Color: meet each case with its top layer turned, and in every color.
• F2L Corner Quiz: name the sticker a corner hides.
• Execution Drill: time a case and beat your best.

GUIDES
• The CFOP method step by step: Overview, Cross, F2L, OLL and PLL. The Cross guide starts from the daisy, for a first cross.
• Example Solve: watch one whole solve on the 3D cube, with every step and case named.
• Notation, with every move shown on a cube.
• Finger Patterns: the triggers and grips behind fast turning.

MADE FOR THE WAY YOU CUBE
• Your color scheme and the way you hold the cube.
• Light, Dark or System appearance.
• English, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese or German, switched right in the app.
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with two-column layouts on wide screens and hardware keyboard shortcuts.

One purchase. No ads, no subscription, no account and no usage analytics.

tr.description:
1990 年，长庄小区一桩离奇母子命案，拉开了跨越五季、长达三十集的庞大中式刑侦悬疑宇宙序幕。

《孙美琪疑案》是一款第一人称 3D 沉浸式硬核探案推理游戏。你将化身刑警刘青春，从第一季《孙美琪》出发，沿着《方婷婷》《王思凤》《王爱国》《杜翠兰》一路深入至第五季终章，孤身踏入上世纪九十年代的老旧居民楼、精神病院、深夜小学、废弃工厂、国际列车、古墓密室与异乡公寓，在极具年代感与压迫感的真实案发现场中搜集隐藏线索，通过“线索关联”层层抽丝剥茧，还原每一桩离奇案件背后令人脊背发凉的真相。

【7.0 五季大合集核心亮点】
• 第 1～5 季、全 30 集一站式收录：完整囊括系列第 1 季至第 5 季全部 30 部独立案件，一集一个独立故事，五季暗线草蛇灰线、环环相扣，老玩家重温与新玩家入坑一步到位。
• 按需分包，轻装上阵：首集内置即玩，其余 29 集支持按需单独下载与随时清理释放空间；支持多集后台排队下载，下载期间可自由畅玩已下载关卡，并内置 4G/5G 移动网络流量确认提醒。
• 硬核 3D 搜证与脑图推理：自由探索阴森写实的 3D 案发现场，不放过每一封信件、每一道划痕与每一件证物；在脑图中将多条线索组合关联，推导全新线索直至锁定核心真相。
• 贴心探案辅助：提供「线索扫描」与脑图「一键关联」辅助功能，卡关时助你快速找回推理思路，既保留硬核解谜成就感，也不再为找不到微小物件而苦恼。

High-quality on-device transcription. Easily convert speech to text from meetings, lectures, and more.

The transcription is powered by OpenAI's Whisper running locally on your device. Nothing leaves your device.

You can export the transcription as subtitles too. It has a word-replacement feature to let you automatically fix common mistakes.

Aiko favors accuracy over speed.

It does not do live transcription while recording.
It does not currently have speaker detection.


Try the trial first. See website.

Note: Sharing from Voice Memos on iOS 26 does not work because of a iOS 26 bug outside of my control.


Supports audio in 100 different languages:
Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Assamese, Azerbaijani, Bangla, Bashkir, Basque, Belarusian, Bosnian, Breton, Bulgarian, Burmese, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Faroese, Finnish, French, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hausa, Hawaiian, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lingala, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Macedonian, Malagasy, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Marathi, Mongolian, Māori, Nepali, Norwegian, Norwegian Nynorsk, Occitan, Pashto, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Sanskrit, Serbian, Shona, Sindhi, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamil, Tatar, Telugu, Thai, Tibetan, Turkish, Turkmen, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Welsh, Yiddish, Yoruba


The app was made possible thanks to Whisper by OpenAI and whisper.cpp by Georgi Gerganov.


■ FAQ

‣ Can I edit the text in the app?

I don't plan to support any editing. Export the transcription and edit it in a proper text editor.

‣ Why is the app so large?

The app delivers the highest quality transcription on the market for 100 different languages. Rather than asking why it's so large, the real question is how is it so small.

‣ Why is the transcription so slow?

The app favors accuracy over speed. However, performance is expected to improve in the coming months.

‣ Why must I keep the iOS app open while it transcribes?

iOS apps are fundamentally restricted from operating in the background for extended periods.

‣ Can I delete some of the languages to save space?

This is unfortunately not possible. The model has all the languages stored together in a way that makes it impossible to remove just some languages.


More FAQs on the website.


■ Technical details

The app uses the Whisper medium or small model on iOS depending on available memory and the large v3 model on macOS.


■ Privacy

The transcription is done locally on your device. Nothing leaves your device.


■ Support

You can contact me through the feedback button in the app.

Hang everything you own on a tag. Keeps 2.0 stamps each thing's cost per use on it, and every use marks it down.

Keeps is a home for the things you own — and an honest answer to what each of them costs you.

Add an item with a photo, its price, and the day you bought it. Keeps divides the price by the days you've owned it, so a jacket you wear every week and a gadget you forgot in a drawer stop looking the same. Watch the cost per day fall the longer you keep something, and see when it will halve again.

WHAT YOU OWN, IN ONE PLACE
• Photos, purchase details, warranty dates, notes, and tags for every item
• Categories you define, with your own icons and order
• A collection you can search, filter, and sort by what it costs you

WHAT IT REALLY COSTS
• Cost per day, from the price and the days owned
• Cost per use — tell Keeps how often you reach for something, or log uses yourself
• Sold or retired something? Keeps counts what you got back
• An overview of your spending by month and category

ADD THINGS THE EASY WAY
• Import Amazon orders, a receipt PDF, or a spreadsheet — photos and prices included
• Paste any product page and Keeps reads the name, price, and photo
• Review every purchase before it joins your collection; returns and duplicates are set aside

MAKE IT LOOK LIKE YOURS

• Search the web for a better picture, right inside Keeps

SMART, ON YOUR DEVICE

pt.description:
Jogue os capítulos 1 a 10 grátis. Uma única compra libera todos os 40 capítulos.

No arsenal do antigo reino de Veyrholm, armas famintas dormiam. Elas devoraram as almas do rei e do povo, até que os Nove Guardiões as acorrentaram e selaram. O jogo começa no dia em que o primeiro selo se rompe.

Você é uma dessas armas. Os ataques são automáticos: mova-se com o joystick à esquerda e use a sua habilidade de movimento com o botão à direita. Cada vez que você corta um inimigo, a sua Fome enche um pouco. Quando a Fome acaba, a arma dorme e a partida termina. Use as Almas juntadas na partida para gravar Lascas na Anatomia da Arma, e na próxima partida você acorda mais forte na mesma medida.

A cada nível você escolhe 1 entre 3 cartas de maldição. Se levar uma carta de ataque ao máximo tendo a carta de suporte que forma par com ela, ela evolui. As relíquias que os Elites derrubam mudam as regras da partida em vez dos seus atributos.

- 6 armas: Espada Maldita, Machado Maldito, Arco Maldito, Cajado Maldito, Lâminas Gêmeas Malditas e Lança Amaldiçoada. Cada uma tem seu ataque básico e sua habilidade de movimento (Avanço, Salto, Rolamento, Lampejo, Ventania), e derrotar pela primeira vez o Chefão de certos capítulos desperta novas armas.
- 8 áreas e 40 capítulos. São quatro dificuldades (Novato, Fácil, Normal e Difícil), e, no jogo completo, vencer o capítulo 5 abre o Modo Infinito.
- Quatro capítulos da primeira área têm cada um a sua cara: um ossário à luz de velas, uma cripta de esgoto por onde corre água, um santuário de ossos violeta e uma capela subterrânea iluminada pela lua e por vitrais.
- 8 Guardiões, 8 capitães de Elite e 8 Subchefes mais fortes lutam cada um com técnicas próprias. Todo ataque é avisado antes.
- 19 cartas de ataque, 23 cartas de suporte, 22 evoluções, 21 relíquias e 7 Familiares.
- A Anatomia da Arma é uma espada em pé com quatro ramos e 159 Lascas.
- A Forja tem 5 espaços de Peças, e afiar com Pedras de Afiar nunca falha e vai até +20. Em +5, +10, +15 e +20 o efeito sobe mais uma vez.
- Visual: personalize as 7 partes de cada arma, com 6.434 visuais entre as 6 armas. Há 90 conjuntos para equipar de uma vez, incluindo os das edições Joseon, Natal, Biscoitos, Lanchonete e Banho público. Eles abrem conforme você vence capítulos e derrota inimigos, e nada é comprado com dinheiro.
- Depois do final, abrem-se 10 Níveis de Maldição. Também há recordes por arma e a Recompensa do dia.
- Durante a partida também aparecem um Espectro do tesouro que foge, um Altar amaldiçoado de onde saem Elites e um Mímico que se passa por baú.
- Os capítulos 1 a 10 (o ossuário e o mosteiro, com a Espada e o Machado) são grátis. Uma única compra de "Liberar jogo completo" abre os 40 capítulos, as 6 armas, o final e os Níveis de Maldição, mantendo seu progresso. Se você já comprou o jogo, tudo continua liberado. Sem anúncios e sem gacha. O progresso fica salvo no aparelho.
- Disponível em coreano, inglês, chinês simplificado, chinês tradicional, russo, português do Brasil, espanhol e alemão.

Do mesmo desenvolvedor: Sasinpae, um roguelike de cartas em que você enfrenta dokkaebis dos contos populares coreanos.

pt.description:
SessionBand Jazz Fusion – Tom Cawley Special Synth & Vintage Keys Edition

Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app.

With over 20,000 precision-cut, chord-based loops across 15 diverse Jazz Fusion styles included, the app instantly converts the chords you select into great-sounding audio - wherever you are and whatever your ability. Perfect for songwriters and producers and the ultimate play-along for jazz rock and pop instrumentalists.

Highly acclaimed, multi award-winning pianist Tom Cawley is one of the most sought-after keyboard players in the world both as a jazz pianist (Dave Weckl, Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker...), and as a leading pop/rock keyboardist, recording and performing around the world with U2, Peter Gabriel, Andrea Bocelli, Amy Winehouse and many others.

For this special Jazz Fusion edition, Tom is joined by 2 of the world's top session musicians: Simon Lea – Drums (Rod Stewart, Dionne Warwick, James Blunt, James Morrison, Katie Melua...) and Geoff Gascoyne – Bass (Sting, Van Morrison, Georgie Fame...).

Tom's passion for jazz and for modern and vintage keys is reflected in the diverse range of styles in this edition. And Tom has employed many of the best keyboards from his vast personal collection: from the Oberheim OB-6, Prophet 12 and Moog Model D (as well as a modular set-up), to his vintage Fender Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Hohner Pianet - they all feature in the content of this app. And to do full justice to this genre, we have increased the number of chord variations to 15 for every root note in all 15 styles!

Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier.

Create professional Jazz Fusion to your own choice of chords in minutes. Everything you need to create and share thousands of stunning royalty-free tracks.

pt.description:
Toastie turns your iPhone into a toaster. Work through the orders on the menu, let the chef surprise you, or make your own sandwich from everything in the kitchen.

Make a grilled cheese sandwich from scratch: butter the bread, lay on the cheese and fillings, and put it in the toaster. Close the lid and it starts toasting in real time. Open it too early and the cheese hasn't melted; leave it too long and it burns. Take it out at the right moment and you get a perfect toastie.

HOW IT WORKS
• Butter the bread with your finger: cover the slice, on the right side.
• Drag the cheese and fillings onto the bread and spread them out.
• Hurry: customers are waiting. You have 20 seconds to build each order.
• Press GRILL, close the lid, and wait for the sizzle.
• Open it to check, or trust your timing, then serve.
• Every sandwich gets a score card: recipe, plating, toasting and prep time. Five stars turn it gold.
• Four stars unlock the next recipe.

NEW: CHEF'S CHOICE
A surprise order from 100 new recipes, dealt at random. Make it, shuffle for another, and see how long a streak you can keep going.

NEW: TOAST-OFF
Challenge a friend face to face, on one iPad or an opened iPhone Duo. You both get the same orders: build, grill and serve. After one, three, five or seven rounds, the most stars wins.

NEW: RELAXED MODE
Like to take your time? Switch on Relaxed mode in Settings and play every order without the clock.

MAKE YOUR OWN
No ticket, no clock. Pick a loaf and put on whatever you like, from every ingredient in the kitchen. Grill it, and the cook tells you what worked and what to change. Give your sandwich a name and save it: your saved toasties now sync with iCloud across your devices. Under CUSTOMIZE you pick the plate, the table and the wall, from eight of each.

THE CAFÉ MENU, NOW 25 ORDERS
Ten new orders join the fifteen from cafés around the world. Clear all 25 for awards of their own.

LANDSCAPE ON IPHONE
On iPhone, orders play in landscape, with more room to build and grill. Prefer portrait? Switch back any time in Settings.

THE MENUS
Work through the House Menu, from a Classic Grilled Cheese and Cheese & Tomato to Brie & Cranberry, Mushroom & Taleggio and The Works. Then explore the Café Menu, with a Caprese, a Chicken Pesto Panini, a Kimchi Tuna Melt and a Guacamole Melt. All on white sandwich loaf, sourdough, brioche or ciabatta.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Toastie plays on any iPhone and iPad. On iPhone Duo, the phone itself becomes the toaster: fold it shut to close the lid, and open it to see how your sandwich is doing. Opened, it plays Toast-Off too.

NOW IN SEVEN LANGUAGES
English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

ALSO
• Share a picture of your toastie.
• Your progress syncs with iCloud across your devices.
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements.
• No ads, no in-app purchases. Pay once.

The world's most expensive toaster.

pt.releaseNotes:
YOUR BACKUPS AT A GLANCE
The main screen is rebuilt around what's most relevant: whether a backup is running, how long it will take, and what all your backups have added up to.

MIRRORING
Photos and Files backups can now follow your library and folders: items you delete leave the backup too. A Deleted folder keeps them first, for as long as you choose.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
The main screen meets the fold with the status on one half and the controls on the other, and fits the outer screen when closed.

SHORTCUTS AND SIRI, REIMAGINED
A new Start Backup action replaces Start Photo Backup and Start File Backup, joined by actions to stop a backup and ask how it is going. Your existing shortcuts keep working.
 ALSO IN THIS UPDATE
• The Live Activity has been redesigned.
• Much improved error reporting.
• New progress sounds. You can turn them off in Settings.
• Many other small improvements and bug fixes.
• Version 2.0.1: Minor fixes and new screenshots.

Version 2.0.2
• New: Option to keep deleted items forever.
• Fixed a crash shortly after starting a backup.
• More reliable mirroring, free space and progress for network share Destinations.

Version 2.0.3
• Drive or network share not connected? Parachute Backup now tells you which destination to connect, in the app, on the Lock Screen and in a notification. The backup continues on its own once it is back.
• Backups started from Shortcuts now wait for a network share that takes a while to reconnect, instead of stopping.
• When your cloud storage asks you to sign in again, the backup stops right away instead of waiting for hours. Sign in from the main screen and the backup runs again.
• The Keep Items duration for mirrored Files backups no longer snaps back to 90 Days.
• Photos Settings on iPhone now shows your changes right away.
• The Destination row shows drive or share and folder, like "NAS ▸ Backups".
• Fixed random characters in front of some network share names.

Version 2.0.4
• When a download from iCloud stalls, a countdown now shows how long Parachute Backup waits for it.
• Stop now ends a backup right away, also while it waits for a download.
• Unchanged items in OneDrive folders with more than 200 items are no longer uploaded again on every backup.
• Items with "%20" in their name now copy to S3 instead of failing with a permission error.
• Network shares: Start Backup in Shortcuts no longer reports an error while the backup waits for the share, and you get one notification instead of two when the wait runs out.
• A document that a network share refused to replace is no longer reported as a Photos library that is not included.

Version 2.0.5
• Fixes a blank screen on iPadOS 27.3 beta.
• Some NAS models do not provide a folder listing to iPhone and iPad. Parachute Backup now detects that situation, keeps backing up, and tells you why deletions cannot be mirrored.
• Before you add a folder on a NAS as a Destination, Parachute Backup now checks it for known problems and tells you about them.
• When a photo or video fails to copy, you now see whether it comes from the Photo Library or from a shared album, and which album.
• A backup that lasts less than a second no longer shows 0 s.
pt.description:
Parachute is your backup companion for iCloud Photos and iCloud Drive. It backs up your memories — photos, videos, and documents — to storage you control, whether that’s an external drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 Buckets, network drives/NAS, external hard drives and more. With Parachute, you get peace of mind and full ownership of your data, free from lock-in.

Your Data, Your Way
	•	Back up your entire iCloud Photos library (including Shared Albums) and folders from iCloud Drive.
	•	Preserve originals in full resolution, all adjustment data, and the current edited versions.
	•	Works with USB drives, NAS/SMB/SFTP mounts, Google Drive, S3 Buckets, OneDrive, external hard drives and more

Key Features
	•	Backups can be triggered from the main screen to any of your backup destinations
	•	Automate backups with Shortcuts integration and Schedules
	•	Privacy-first: transfers handled via Apple’s Files extensions — your credentials never touch our app.
	•	Supports full-quality media: Live Photos + videos, RAW images, bursts, edits, and slow motion.

Why It Matters
	•	iCloud sync ≠ backup — deletions, expired storage, or sync errors can mean permanent loss.
	•	Parachute safeguards your digital life from accidents and disasters.
	•	Your files are stored in normal folders you can browse and restore from directly — no special tools needed.

One time purchase. No Lock-In.
	•	One-time purchase unlocks all backup functionality — no recurring fees.
	•	Your data stays in your storage, not ours.
	•	No accounts, no telemetry, no background bloat.


FAQ Highlights

Q: Does Parachute ever delete files from iCloud?
A: Never. It’s strictly read-only.

Q: Can I restore without Parachute?
A: Yes. Backups are just normal folders — copy them back with Finder anytime.

Q: What if a file is corrupted in iCloud?
A: Parachute flags any unexportable items so you know exactly what couldn’t be saved.

Q: Can it back up non-iCloud folders?
A: Yes. Add any folder via the iOS/iPadOS file picker

By downloading Parachute Backup, you agree to Apple's Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and our Privacy Policy (https://parachuteapps.com/privacy).

Embarca numa aventura épica em EvoCreo 2, o RPG de captura de monstros no mundo de Shoru. Descobre criaturas míticas chamadas Creo, que vagam pela terra com origens e evolução misteriosas. pt.description:
HUDDLE UP FOR BACKYARD FOOTBALL

Backyard Football 1999 is now enhanced to run on modern systems. Whether you're picking Jerry Rice or Barry Sanders for your dream team, rushing with Pete Wheeler, scoring touchdowns with Pablo Sanchez, or enjoying the witty banter of hosts Sunny Day and Chuck Downfield, simple controls let anyone pick up and play football!

GAME MODES
Single Game: With 5 backyard fields and unique weather condition settings, players can pick their team, design their team logos, and play a pick-up game!
Season Mode: Players can draft seven players from the 30 iconic Backyard Sports characters and a collection of legendary pros including Barry Sanders, Jerry Rice, John Elway, Dan Marino, Randall Cunningham, Drew Bledsoe and Steve Young to compete against 15 other teams in the Backyard Football League. Each team plays a 14-game season. By the end of the regular season, the 4 division champions and 4 wild card teams enter the Backyard Football League Playoffs to compete for the Super Colossal Cereal Bowl!

EARN CLASSIC POWER UPS
Earn power-ups by completing passes on offense and sacking the opposing QB on defense.

Offensive
• Hocus Pocus – A pass play which results in a receiver teleporting down field.
• Sonic Boom – A run play which causes an earthquake to knock over the opposing team.
• Leap Frog – A run play which causes your running back to leap down field.
• Super Punt – A very powerful punt!

Defensive
• Cough Drop – A play that causes the opponent to fumble when tackled.
• Chameleon – A trick play that results in your team wearing the other team's colors for ultimate confusion.
• Spring Loaded – A play that causes your player to leap over the line of scrimmage to sack the QB.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver.

Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. However, Backyard Football ‘99 runs well, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

Relive the second baseball game in the Backyard Sports franchise, now enhanced to run on iOS. Whether you're picking your dream team, playing a pick-up game, or diving into a full season, step up to the plate and experience the game that made baseball fun for everyone!

Backyard Baseball ‘01 teams up the Backyard kids with Backyardified MLB legends. Create your own Backyard team, customize your uniforms, and strategize to win the Championship. Play a single pick-up game or play through an entire season. Backyard Baseball ‘01 features intuitive controls for all ages!

SWING BACK INTO BASEBALL
Enjoy baseball like it’s 2001!
30 Charming Backyard kids
Legendary MLB Players
MLB Team Marks
Hilarious Bloopers
8 Classic Ballparks
9 Pitching Power-ups and 4 batting Power-ups
Lively commentary from Sunny Day and Vinnie

To get into the swing of things, choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit the ball!

THE GOAT RETURNS
Play with the legend himself, Pablo Sanchez. Build a roster from a cast of 30 hilarious child athletes and 28 legendary pros that made Backyard Baseball ‘01 a sports classic. Returning MLB players include Derek Jeter, Alex Rodriguez, Cal Ripken Jr., Sammy Sosa, Mike Piazza, Randy Johnson, Nomar Garciaparra, Jeff Bagwell, Jason Giambi, Chipper Jones, Jeromy Burnitz, Mark McGwire, Shawn Green, Vladimir Guerrero, Kenny Lofton, Jason Kendall, Barry Larkin, Marty Cordova, Mo Vaughn, Raul Mondesi, Curt Schilling, Alex Gonzalez, Juan Gonzalez, Larry Walker, Carlos Beltran, Tony Gwynn, Ivan Rodriguez, and Jose Canseco.

Choose from three modes of play (Easy Mode, Medium Mode, Hard Mode)
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer choosing players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You pick your home field, create a team, and manage the team through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver.

Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. As an example, we can’t use the original 32bit code to support modern macOS, as even with an incredibly clever wrapper, macOS can’t execute the binaries.

Backyard Baseball ‘01 runs well, looks better than ever, includes new bonus features to test your mettle, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

pt.description:
Solo is the ultimate practice App for mastering fretboard visualization, designed by world renowned guitarists Tom Quayle and David Beebee.

Four powerful fretboard trainers allow you to work intuitively on each aspect of the visualization process; learning note names, memorising interval shapes, outlining chord changes, and practicing scales.

Solo asks you to find intervallic functions against one root note, chord symbol or scale at a time, listens to the notes you play, and doesn’t move on until you’ve correctly found each note by its intervallic function in the specified order.

Practice with Solo and finally learn your note names, master interval shapes, confidently play through chord changes and break out of scale boxes with intervallic functions. Start transforming your playing and confidence on the fretboard today!


NOTE TRAINER
The Note Trainer is perfect for beginner and intermediate players getting to grips with note names on the neck - the foundation of solid fretboard knowledge. 

‣ Solo shows you random root notes to find and listens, waiting for you to get it correct.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Optional practice suggestions offer challenging ways to limit and test yourself.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


INTERVAL TRAINER
The Interval Trainer will help players at all levels work on interval shapes with intervallic functions - the key to unlocking true freedom on the fretboard.

‣ Choose any combination of intervallic functions to practice.
‣ Create custom interval groups or choose the intervals for ANY chord type or scale.
‣ The Interval Trainer will randomise your chosen intervals and ask you to find them against either a fixed or random root note.
‣ Slide on the interactive fretboards for helpful diagrams, showing you where all of the interval shapes are across the neck, and to study alternative options. Choose from 6 string guitar (standard and 4ths tuning), 7 string guitar, 4 string bass & 5 string bass.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.


CHANGES TRAINER
In the Changes Trainer you find intervallic functions, using single notes to outline different chord types or sets of chord changes, a key skill for learning to improvise through chord changes.  

‣ Practice outlining intervallic functions through over 100 common chord progressions and single chord exercises.
‣ 50 intervallic function levels. Go from simple chord tones to complex melodic structures and scales. 
‣ Solo intelligently maps out the correct intervals over each chord and listens for you to play each intervallic function in the specified order.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Transpose the key of any progression or exercise. 
‣ Choose to randomly transpose the progression (or single chord exercise) each time it repeats.
‣ Work on voice leading chord tones through single note lines.


SCALE TRAINER
The Scale Trainer contains a vast array of scales and powerful workout options, allowing you to finally break out of the box and develop a much deeper understanding of how scales are constructed on the fretboard.

‣ Practice finding scales on the fretboard using intervallic functions. 
‣ Over 50+ Scales and modes.
‣ Powerful workout options provide almost limitless ways to challenge yourself.
‣ Melodic sequence options let you focus on starting from any chord tone within the scale.
‣ Duration based workouts allow you to craft the perfect practice session.

LumaFusion: a melhor experiência narrativa para edição de vídeos

Bem-vindo ao "App do Ano 2021" da App Store e vencedor do Editors' Choice Award! O padrão ouro para criadores de conteúdo no mundo todo. Uma experiência de edição fluida, intuitiva, projetada para telas sensíveis ao toque.

EDIÇÃO PROFISSIONAL FACILITADA
• Seis faixas de vídeo/áudio ou gráficos: crie edições de múltiplas camadas com manuseio fácil de mídia 4K ProRes e HDR.
• Seis faixas de áudio adicionais: construa seu ambiente sonoro.
• A linha do tempo ideal: edição fluente usando a linha do tempo magnética e guiada mais flexível do mundo.
• Muitas transições: mantenha sua história em movimento.
• Prévia no monitor externo: veja em uma tela grande.
• Marcadores, tags e notas: mantenha-se organizado.
• Locução: grave VO enquanto reproduz seu filme.

EFEITOS EM CAMADAS E CORREÇÃO DE COR
• Tela verde, luma e chroma key: para a composição criativa.
• Estabilizador de vídeo Lock & Load: mantenha sua filmagem estável.
• Correção de cores poderosa: crie o seu próprio visual.
• Formas de onda de vídeo, escopo vetorial e histograma.
• LUTs: Importe e aplique múltiplas LUTs .cube ou .3dl.
• Quadros-chave ilimitados: anime efeitos com precisão.
• Presets de textos e efeitos personalizáveis: salve e compartilhe suas animações e visuais favoritos.
• Grades e guias: alinhe elementos com título seguro, ação segura e linha de horizonte.

CONTROLE DE ÁUDIO AVANÇADO
• Equalizador gráfico, equalizador paramétrico e isolamento de voz: sintonize o áudio.
• Níveis de áudio de quadro-chave, panorâmica e equalizador: crie mixagens perfeitas.
• Suporte para áudio estéreo e mono duplo: para entrevistas com vários microfones em um clipe.
• Redução de áudio: equilibre sua música e seu diálogo.
• Plug-ins de áudio externos: aprimore seu som.

TÍTULOS CRIATIVOS E TEXTO MULTICAMADAS
• Títulos multicamadas: combine formas, imagens e textos em seu gráfico.
• Fontes, cores, bordas e sombras personalizáveis: crie títulos atrativos.
• Importe fontes personalizadas: fortaleça sua marca.
• Salve e compartilhe presets de títulos: perfeito para colaboração.

FLEXIBILIDADE DE PROJETOS E BIBLIOTECA DE MÍDIA
• Proporções para todos os usos: do cinema panorâmico às redes sociais.
• Taxas de quadros de 18 fps a 240 fps: flexibilidade para qualquer cenário.
• Edite a partir das Fotos, Frame.io e diretamente de unidades USB-C: acesse seu conteúdo em qualquer lugar.
• Importe mídias do armazenamento na nuvem: onde quer que você as armazene.

COMPARTILHE SUAS OBRAS-PRIMAS
• Controle resolução, qualidade e formato.
• Compartilhar filmes em redes sociais, armazenamento local ou armazenamento em nuvem.
• Edite em vários dispositivos: transfira projetos com facilidade.

RECURSOS AVANÇADOS (compre individualmente ou obtenha TODOS como parte da assinatura do Creator Pass - veja abaixo)
• Aceleração de Velocidade e Keyframing Aprimorado - Crie rampas de velocidade, curvas de Bézier e easing com este recurso único e fácil de usar.
• Exportação XML: Exporte seu projeto para o Final Cut Pro para Mac
• Multicam Studio: sincronize 6 câmeras ou áudio e toque para alternar ângulos

ASSINATURA CREATOR PASS
• Obtenha acesso total ao Storyblocks para LumaFusion: milhões de músicas, efeitos sonoros e vídeos isentos de direitos autorais de alta qualidade, além de obter todos os recursos aprimorados acima.

pt.description:
O esquadrão chegou ao teu dispositivo móvel! Evita uma tempestade de balas e enfrenta temíveis máquinas de guerra aéreas! Lidera o teu esquadrão até à vitória em duas campanhas diferentes, repletas de reviravoltas na história e combates  com chefes lendários!

ASES DA LUFTWAFFE - ESQUADRÃO é um jogo de tiros de rolagem vertical repleto de ação com uma narrativa fascinante e totalmente falada. Desvia-te de balas, recolhe power-ups massivos e usa sabiamente habilidades especiais para derrotares os teus inimigos. Duas campanhas com 50 níveis no total, ataques de vários inimigos mortais e muitas lutas épicas contra chefes. Estás preparado para a tarefa?

Quando a Europa parecia estar livre, um comando secreto alemão chamado Os Ases da Luftwaffe teve a oportunidade de se vingar e invadir os EUA! É teu dever restaurar a paz e a liberdade a bordo de asas mortais de aço em batalhas aéreas bombásticas! No entanto, qualquer história tem dois lados. Enquanto os Ases da Luftwaffe começam o seu ataque aos Estados Unidos, tu és encarregado de liderar um esquadrão de pilotos alemães de elite numa missão secreta. Entra numa aventura aérea épica de intrigas e rasteiras com uma base secreta no Triângulo das Bermudas. Escolhe o teu lado, decide o teu papel e descola!

- Jogo de tiros com efeitos especiais explosivos

pt.description:
Queime borracha e destrua metal no maior circuito de corrida livre que há!

Wreckfest possui uma paulada de opções de melhorias e personalizações. Você pode se preparar para a próxima corrida de demolição com para-choques reforçados, santantônios, protetores laterais e muito mais, ou pode preparar o carro para uma Corrida Lata Velha com peças de desempenho de motor como filtros de ar, árvores de cames, sistemas de combustível etc. Wreckfest está se tornando o melhor jogo de combate motorizado que existe.

pt.description:
Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997! Build your roster from the iconic cast of 30 characters stacked with charming personalities and witty banter, and get the edge on the competition with power-ups, fireball pitches, super strength, and Pablo Sanchez!
Play pick-up games, practice batting, and compete in single games or a whole season with simple, intuitive controls that anyone can master!
Game Modes:
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself, and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer to choose players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You create a team and manage it through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At the end of the season the best two teams advance to the BBL playoffs (best of 3). The winner advances to the championship series which consists of the Super Entire Nation Tournament (best of 3) and then the Ultra Grand Championship of the Universe Series (best of 5)!
Batting Practice: Choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit that ball!
T-ball - Select T-ball mode for more accessible game play. Simply click to hit, run, and field!
 
BACKYARD BASEBALL RULES
The rules for Backyard Baseball are a hybrid of Pro and Little League rules:
No leading off
No Injuries
Bunting is allowed
Tagging up is allowed
Stealing is allowed
 
At our core, we are fans first–not just of video games but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. Backyard Baseball '97 runs buttery smooth for iOS devices, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the title that started it all.

pt.description:
Just Press Record é o gravador de áudio que grava, transcreve e sincroniza com iCloud e todos os seus dispositivos, com um toque. Edite transcrições de áudio direto no aplicativo e até mesmo inicie uma nova gravação, tudo sem usar as mãos, com a Siri!

A vida é repleta de momentos memoráveis, como as primeiras palavras do seu filho, reuniões importantes ou ideias espontâneas. Capture momentos sem esforço no iPhone, no iPad e no Mac ou, para ter total praticidade, no Apple Watch.

GRAVE
• Toque para iniciar, interromper, pausar e reiniciar a gravação.
• Inicie e interrompa a gravação pelos atalhos, no Siri, no widget, ações rápidas do 3D Touch ou pelo esquema do URL.
• Tempo de gravação ilimitado.
• Grave discretamente em segundo plano.
• Grave com o microfone interno, com AirPods ou microfones externos.
• Grave independente no Apple Watch e sincronize depois.

TOQUE
• Procure para trás e à frente na reprodução.
• Velocidade de reprodução ajustável.

TRANSCREVA
• Transforme voz em texto para pesquisa.
• Compatível com 30+ idiomas em qualquer configuração de idioma do aparelho.
• Destaque de texto e reprodução de áudio sincronizados.
• Formate enquanto grava com comandos de pontuação.

EDITE
• Áudio - veja o áudio no formato de forma de onda e corte as partes de que não precisa.
• Texto - faça correções e adicione novos textos às transcrições.

COMPARTILHE
• Compartilhe áudio e texto com outros aplicativos.
• Compartilhe em redes sociais como trecho de vídeo.
• Compartilhe no iTunes, no Mac ou no PC via cabo USB.
• Imprima uma cópia das suas transcrições.
• Compartilhe arquivos de áudio de outros aplicativos com o Just Press Record. 

ORGANIZE
• Consulte gravações recentes ou da biblioteca por data e horário.
• Pesquise por nome de arquivo ou transcrição.
• Guia dedicada ao acesso rápido às gravações do Apple Watch.
• Renomeie gravações.
• Compatível com Slide Over e Split View no iPad.
• Adicione selo ao ícone do aplicativo com número de gravações não reproduzidas.

ARMAZENAMENTO
• Armazene as gravações no iCloud Drive ou no dispositivo local.
• Gravações armazenadas no iCloud Drive são sincronizadas entre dispositivos.
• As gravações armazenadas no local se beneficiam da integração do aplicativo de arquivos e do compartilhamento automático de arquivos do iTunes.
• Transcrições são armazenadas no arquivo de áudio.

ÁUDIO PRO
• Compatível com gravação estéreo a partir do microfone interno de dispositivos compatíveis.
• Compatível com microfones externos de alta qualidade pela porta Lightning.
• Configurações ajustáveis para otimizar a experiência de áudio.
• Tipos de arquivo: WAV, AIF ou iTunes M4A padrão (ACC).
• Áudio de alta qualidade, até 96 kHz/24 bits.

ACESSIBILIDADE
• Compatível com VoiceOver no aplicativo.
• Gesto Magic Tap para iniciar/interromper gravação.

APPLE WATCH
Just Press Record conta com aplicativo para Apple Watch que permite gravar em qualquer lugar, mesmo sem o iPhone disponível.

• Comece a gravar com um único toque na Complicação.
• Grave discretamente em segundo plano.
• Tempo de gravação ilimitado.
• Gravações transferidas automaticamente para iPhone para transcr/sinc no iCloud.
• Ouça as gravações recentes no alto-falante interno ou nos AirPods.
• Ajuste o volume com a Digital Crown.
• Pause a gravação deslizando para baixo.
• Recursos de acessibilidade com VoiceOver, movimento reduzido, compatibilidade com modelo extra grande de Complicação.

IMPORTANTE:
• O Just Press Record não grava chamadas telefônicas ou áudio de outros aplicativos.
• A transcrição exibe um sinal de áudio bom e claro.  Evite gravar em ambientes ruidosos e posicione o microfone próximo à fonte de som.
• Esquema de URL implementado pelo Just Press Record está na página de FAQ.

pt.releaseNotes:
NEW IN 7.2
• Keep screen awake now has three choices in Settings: Off, While Studying and Always. While Studying keeps the screen on while you read an algorithm, study flashcards or practice, and lets it dim as usual everywhere else. If you had the switch on, it is now Always.
• Bracketed groups such as (R U R') now stay on one line in the quizzes, on flashcards and in the algorithm editor, instead of breaking across two lines.

IN CASE YOU MISSED 7.1
• Cube CFOP now speaks Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese and German. Choose in Settings > Language; the app switches right away. Case names and notation stay as cubers write them.
• 2-Sided PLL Quiz: name the PLL case from the top and the two sides you see, as on the cube in your hands.
• Random Front Color: a new PLL quiz option beside Random AUF, so a case comes in every color. Both start off, and each quiz remembers your choice.
• OLL, PLL and 2-Sided PLL quizzes now ask every case once before any comes again. A case you miss or skip returns a few cases later.
• Copy Algorithm: copy any algorithm from its menu, ready to paste into a timer or a note.
• You can now delete the last algorithm of a side angle. Front always keeps one.
• OLL 2-Look step one now names its cases L-shape, Line and Dot instead of 1-1, 1-2 and 1-3.

IN CASE YOU MISSED 7.0.1
• OLL and PLL cases have four viewing angles: Front, Right, Back and Left. Each is drawn and played in 3D from that side and holds the algorithms you write for it. On a side angle, Create from Front writes its algorithm from your Front one.

IN CASE YOU MISSED 7.0
Cube CFOP 7.0 is rebuilt from the ground up, with new ways to learn and practice every case.

• Learning: a new tab with four-grade flashcards (Again, Hard, Good, Easy), daily review, and a report of your streak and study days.
• Practice: OLL and PLL Recognition Quizzes, the F2L Corner Quiz, and a timed Execution Drill.
• Algorithms: watch any algorithm on a 3D cube, add your own alias and note, and search every case. The editor checks that an algorithm solves its case.
• Guides: the CFOP method from Overview to PLL, an Example Solve on the 3D cube, Finger Patterns, and a redrawn Notation guide.
• Also: your cube's colors and grip, Light and Dark appearance, iPhone Duo and iPad two-column layouts, keyboard shortcuts, and a new app icon.
• No usage analytics. The app sends crash reports only.

Your favorites, edited algorithms and flashcard progress carry over. Your algorithm lists stay as they were; to take the new recommended algorithms, use Settings > Restore Default Algorithms.
pt.description:
Learn CFOP, the most popular speedcubing method, one case at a time. Every F2L, OLL and PLL algorithm, with flashcards, quizzes and a timed drill to make them stick.

EVERY CASE OF CFOP
• 41 F2L, 57 OLL and 21 PLL cases, plus 2-Look OLL and 2-Look PLL to get you started.
• Alternative algorithms for many cases: pick the one that suits your hands, or write your own. The editor checks that it solves the case.
• Watch any algorithm on a 3D cube, and tap a move to play up to it.
• See any F2L, OLL or PLL case from each of its four angles, and write the algorithm for that angle, or create it from your Front one.
• Setup moves for each case, and room for your own alias and note.
• Search by name, alias, group or note.

LEARN WITH FLASHCARDS
• Add the cases you are working on to Learning.
• Spaced repetition brings each card back when it is due. Grade it Again, Hard, Good or Easy.
• Practice your hard, new or random cards whenever you like.
• Report: a heat map of your study days, your streak, and what is due in the next 7 days.

PRACTICE UNTIL IT IS AUTOMATIC
• OLL and PLL Recognition Quizzes: name the case from its pattern, against the clock.
• 2-Sided PLL Quiz: name the PLL case from the top and the two sides you see, as on the cube in your hands.
• Random AUF and Random Front Color: meet each case with its top layer turned, and in every color.
• F2L Corner Quiz: name the sticker a corner hides.
• Execution Drill: time a case and beat your best.

GUIDES
• The CFOP method step by step: Overview, Cross, F2L, OLL and PLL. The Cross guide starts from the daisy, for a first cross.
• Example Solve: watch one whole solve on the 3D cube, with every step and case named.
• Notation, with every move shown on a cube.
• Finger Patterns: the triggers and grips behind fast turning.

MADE FOR THE WAY YOU CUBE
• Your color scheme and the way you hold the cube.
• Light, Dark or System appearance.
• English, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese or German, switched right in the app.
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with two-column layouts on wide screens and hardware keyboard shortcuts.

One purchase. No ads, no subscription, no account and no usage analytics.

pt.description:
1990 年，长庄小区一桩离奇母子命案，拉开了跨越五季、长达三十集的庞大中式刑侦悬疑宇宙序幕。

《孙美琪疑案》是一款第一人称 3D 沉浸式硬核探案推理游戏。你将化身刑警刘青春，从第一季《孙美琪》出发，沿着《方婷婷》《王思凤》《王爱国》《杜翠兰》一路深入至第五季终章，孤身踏入上世纪九十年代的老旧居民楼、精神病院、深夜小学、废弃工厂、国际列车、古墓密室与异乡公寓，在极具年代感与压迫感的真实案发现场中搜集隐藏线索，通过“线索关联”层层抽丝剥茧，还原每一桩离奇案件背后令人脊背发凉的真相。

【7.0 五季大合集核心亮点】
• 第 1～5 季、全 30 集一站式收录：完整囊括系列第 1 季至第 5 季全部 30 部独立案件，一集一个独立故事，五季暗线草蛇灰线、环环相扣，老玩家重温与新玩家入坑一步到位。
• 按需分包，轻装上阵：首集内置即玩，其余 29 集支持按需单独下载与随时清理释放空间；支持多集后台排队下载，下载期间可自由畅玩已下载关卡，并内置 4G/5G 移动网络流量确认提醒。
• 硬核 3D 搜证与脑图推理：自由探索阴森写实的 3D 案发现场，不放过每一封信件、每一道划痕与每一件证物；在脑图中将多条线索组合关联，推导全新线索直至锁定核心真相。
• 贴心探案辅助：提供「线索扫描」与脑图「一键关联」辅助功能，卡关时助你快速找回推理思路，既保留硬核解谜成就感，也不再为找不到微小物件而苦恼。
• 独立分集存档管理：30 集进度各自独立保存，支持随时针对单集清空重玩，清空进度不删已下载关卡资源。
• 支持离线畅玩：单集下载完成后即可随时随地离线推理，畅享纯粹的中式悬疑氛围。
• 免费游玩：需要提示时，可选择观看奖励广告获取提示。

跨越五季的迷雾，真相往往藏在最不起眼的角落。准备好手电筒，再次推开那扇门吧。

pt.description:
原 #饥荒语音助手#

不是游戏，而是一款帮助荒野生存游戏玩家，从新手快速成为大神的小工具

“某某装备怎么合成、有什么使用技巧、原材料如何获取”？

这些问题困扰着每一个饥荒新手玩家。

当碰到这些问题时往往要暂停精彩的游戏，去网上找到答案再返回游戏。浪费时间，超级麻烦吧？

有了本App，你要做的只是轻点一下语音小圆点。

说出相关问题(如”加速手杖怎么合成？豪华风扇有什么用?”)

之后它就会用语音播报出相应的答案。

从而节省宝贵的游戏时间，避免因查找某个装备的合成方法、使用技巧，反复暂停游戏的烦恼。

将更多的精力放在游戏本身，尽情享受游戏带来的乐趣！

除此之外，还拥有 料理配方，生物百科，各DLC开局方式，烹饪锅模拟，荒野厨神等轻娱乐功能！

pt.description:
High-quality on-device transcription. Easily convert speech to text from meetings, lectures, and more.

The transcription is powered by OpenAI's Whisper running locally on your device. Nothing leaves your device.

You can export the transcription as subtitles too. It has a word-replacement feature to let you automatically fix common mistakes.

Aiko favors accuracy over speed.

It does not do live transcription while recording.
It does not currently have speaker detection.


Try the trial first. See website.

Note: Sharing from Voice Memos on iOS 26 does not work because of a iOS 26 bug outside of my control.


Supports audio in 100 different languages:
Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Assamese, Azerbaijani, Bangla, Bashkir, Basque, Belarusian, Bosnian, Breton, Bulgarian, Burmese, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Faroese, Finnish, French, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hausa, Hawaiian, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lingala, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Macedonian, Malagasy, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Marathi, Mongolian, Māori, Nepali, Norwegian, Norwegian Nynorsk, Occitan, Pashto, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Sanskrit, Serbian, Shona, Sindhi, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamil, Tatar, Telugu, Thai, Tibetan, Turkish, Turkmen, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Welsh, Yiddish, Yoruba


The app was made possible thanks to Whisper by OpenAI and whisper.cpp by Georgi Gerganov.


■ FAQ

‣ Can I edit the text in the app?

I don't plan to support any editing. Export the transcription and edit it in a proper text editor.

‣ Why is the app so large?

The app delivers the highest quality transcription on the market for 100 different languages. Rather than asking why it's so large, the real question is how is it so small.

‣ Why is the transcription so slow?

The app favors accuracy over speed. However, performance is expected to improve in the coming months.

‣ Why must I keep the iOS app open while it transcribes?

iOS apps are fundamentally restricted from operating in the background for extended periods.

‣ Can I delete some of the languages to save space?

This is unfortunately not possible. The model has all the languages stored together in a way that makes it impossible to remove just some languages.


More FAQs on the website.


■ Technical details

The app uses the Whisper medium or small model on iOS depending on available memory and the large v3 model on macOS.


■ Privacy

The transcription is done locally on your device. Nothing leaves your device.


■ Support

You can contact me through the feedback button in the app.

== Recomendado várias vezes como Jogo do Dia na App Store. ==

Um mundo alienígena em pedaços. Um esquadrão de 3 Caçadores. Combate em tempo real onde cada elemento conta.
Você será o caçador… ou a presa? Suas batalhas decidem o destino do planeta!

Quando o planeta se partiu, os sobreviventes fugiram para o "Anel" em órbita, com saudade do Lar perdido. Agora os Caçadores voltam ao mundo despedaçado: pela sobrevivência, pela esperança e por um futuro que vale a pena defender.

RECURSOS DO JOGO
- Ação de esquadrão em tempo real — Controle 3 Caçadores ao mesmo tempo em combates rápidos e empolgantes.
- Combos elementais — Queime com Fogo, congele com Gelo ou combine "Fogo + Gelo" para formar "Água" e encharcar as presas. A tática é sua.
- Sem limites — Sem "Energia", sem "Stamina". Explore e colete recursos o quanto quiser.
- Presas bizarras & chefes colossais — Cace os famigerados Capangas, polvos que voam rente ao chão e vermes da areia que dançam o twist… e reze para nunca encontrar a lendária "Mão Gigante".
- Mais de 8 Caçadores, cada um com sua história — Reúna uma turma de marginais cativantes e evolua-os do seu jeito.
- Equipamentos & builds de conjunto — Combine equipamentos, ative bônus de conjunto e crie o time perfeito. Um grande Caçador sempre tem mais de um truque!
- Pixel art retrô refinada — Um mundo alienígena deslumbrante, feito à mão no clássico estilo pixel.

O planeta inteiro é o seu território de caça. Reúna seu esquadrão e vá em frente, Caçador!

------ Uma palavra dos desenvolvedores ------
Já se passaram 5 anos desde o nosso último jogo, "Brutal Street 2". Criar algo novo — e ao mesmo tempo honrar o legado — não foi nada fácil. "Lar, Planeta e Caçador" é um trabalho feito com amor por toda a nossa equipe, e esperamos de coração que você goste.

pt.releaseNotes:
O Keeps 2.0 dá um novo visual a tudo o que tem.

Cada coisa fica pendurada numa etiqueta de preço na cor da sua categoria, com o seu autocolante e o custo por utilização carimbado. Escolha uma cor para cada categoria. As utilizações são picotadas num cartão de utilização, os totais saem como um recibo e cada objetivo alcançado recebe um carimbo.

Ajuste um recorte: deixe o Keeps encontrar a coisa sozinho ou remover um fundo liso, mantenha ou descarte cada objeto que ele encontrar e alargue, encolha ou suavize o contorno. Restaurar e Apagar tratam dos últimos pormenores. As fotos com fundo liso são recortadas de forma mais fiável.

Visão geral, Calendário, importações, Definições, widgets e o Keeps na app Mensagens foram redesenhados a condizer, com novos ícones da app. A primeira abertura mostra agora como os Atalhos podem registar as suas utilizações automaticamente.

No iPad, Gerir itens cabe ao lado das Definições, e escolher outra linha das Definições abre-a sempre.

Importe uma encomenda inteira de uma vez: na página da encomenda de uma loja, um toque adiciona cada artigo com a fotografia, a quantidade e a data da encomenda. No iPhone Duo, a importação a partir de um site ocupa agora todo o ecrã.
pt.description:
Pendure tudo o que tem numa etiqueta. O Keeps 2.0 carimba o custo por utilização em cada coisa, e cada utilização baixa o preço.
Ajuste um recorte até ficar bem: deixe o Keeps encontrar a coisa ou remover um fundo liso e depois molde o contorno.

O Keeps é uma casa para as coisas que tem — e uma resposta honesta ao que cada uma delas lhe custa.

Adicione um item com uma foto, o preço e o dia em que o comprou. O Keeps divide o preço pelos dias em que o tem, para que um casaco que usa todas as semanas e um gadget esquecido numa gaveta deixem de parecer iguais. Veja o custo por dia descer quanto mais tempo mantiver algo, e saiba quando voltará a reduzir para metade.

O QUE TEM, NUM SÓ LUGAR
• Fotos, detalhes de compra, datas de garantia, notas e etiquetas para cada item
• Categorias definidas por si, com os seus próprios ícones e ordem
• Uma coleção que pode pesquisar, filtrar e ordenar pelo que lhe custa

O QUE CUSTA REALMENTE
• Custo por dia, a partir do preço e dos dias de posse
• Custo por utilização — diga ao Keeps com que frequência usa algo, ou registe as utilizações
• Vendeu ou retirou algo? O Keeps conta o que recebeu de volta
• Uma visão geral das suas despesas por mês e categoria

ADICIONE COISAS DA FORMA FÁCIL
• Importe encomendas Amazon, um recibo em PDF ou uma folha de cálculo — com fotos e preços incluídos
• Cole qualquer página de produto e o Keeps lê o nome, o preço e a foto
• Reveja cada compra antes de entrar na coleção; devoluções e duplicados ficam de lado

DÊ-LHE O SEU ESTILO
• Palco: O original mantém-se intacto. Pode mudar como se apresenta ou repor as edições a qualquer momento.
• Pesquise na web uma imagem melhor, sem sair do Keeps

INTELIGENTE, NO SEU DISPOSITIVO
• Descreva um item e receba uma sugestão de nome, categoria e etiquetas, com o Apple Intelligence em dispositivos compatíveis
• Faça perguntas sobre a sua coleção e obtenha respostas a partir dos seus próprios dados

PRIVADO POR NATUREZA
• A sua coleção fica nos seus dispositivos e, se quiser, no seu próprio iCloud
• As compras do Keeps Pro são feitas através da App Store. O RevenueCat recebe registos de compras do Pro, um identificador anónimo da aplicação e as visualizações e toques na página do Keeps Pro, para verificar as compras e apresentar essa página. A coleção, o histórico de compras importado, as fotografias e as notas não são enviados ao RevenueCat.
• Faça cópias de segurança e restaure toda a coleção como um ficheiro

Atalhos e Siri: registe uma utilização, consulte o custo de um item, pesquise ou adicione um item sem abrir a app. As ligações keeps:// abrem qualquer item.

O feedback abre um e-mail editável com o modelo do dispositivo, a versão do sistema e a versão e o número de compilação do Keeps. Não são anexados registos de diagnóstico nem dados da coleção.

Keeps Pro
O Keeps guarda até 10 itens gratuitamente. O Keeps Pro remove o limite. A importação de compras faz parte do Keeps Pro. Pode rever primeiro o conteúdo de um ficheiro. Tudo o que adicionou continua a ser seu, com ou sem Pro. Comprou o Keeps antes de ser gratuito ou tem o Pro vitalício? O Pro já está incluído.
Keeps Pro · Assinatura mensal ou anual, ou uma compra única vitalícia
As assinaturas renovam-se automaticamente, salvo se forem canceladas pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período atual. Pode geri-las ou cancelá-las nas definições da sua conta da App Store.

pt.description:
A morte não é o fim.

Jogue como um experimento de alquimia fracassado e explore o extenso castelo em constante mudança para descobrir o que aconteceu nesta ilha sombria ...!
Isto é, desde que você consiga passar pelos guardiões.

Dead Cells é um jogo de ação em plataforma em estilo roguevania que exige que você domine combates frenéticos 2D com uma grande variedade de armas e habilidades contra inimigos impiedosos.

Matar. Morrer. Aprender. Repetir.

Disponível inicialmente para PC e consoles, o sucesso indie Dead Cells agora está arrasando com os inimigos em dispositivos móveis!

Principais Características
• Roguevania: A exploração progressiva de um mundo interconectado, com a "rejogabilidade" do estilo rogue-lite e a adrenalina da ameaça de morte permanente

• Frenética Ação 2D: Aprenda os padrões de seus inimigos para se manter vivo ou prepare-se para ser enviado de volta à sua cela antes que possa dizer "baguete"

• Progressão Não Linear: Desbloqueie novos níveis a cada morte, opte pelo caminho que mais se adequar ao seu personagem atual, ao seu estilo de jogo ou simplesmente ao seu estado de espírito. Certamente as muralhas não vão ser tão perigosas quanto os esgotos, certo?

• Jogue no seu ritmo - Você vai explorar cada cantinho escuro do castelo, ou vai correr para o final?

*As últimas atualizações estão disponíveis: Clean Cut & The End is Near*

DLC RETORNO A CASTLEVANIA
É hora de caçar vampiros
• Novo enredo - vença o Soberano das Trevas ao lado de Alucard e Richter Belmont,
• 2 novos biomas - Explore o Castelo de Drácula e as suas redondezas
• 9 monstros novos - Lobisomens, armaduras assombradas e medusas esperam por você
• 14 armas novas - empunhe a Matadora de Vampiros ou a Água Benta para derrotar as criaturas da noite,
• 3 novos chefes - vá com unhas e dentes contra a Morte e o próprio Drácula
• 20 novas roupas - vista-se como seus personagens favoritos de Castlevania: Simon e Richter Belmont ou Alucard
• Trilhas sonoras alternativas - jogue ao som de 51 trilhas sonoras originais de Castlevania e 12 músicas reimaginadas no estilo de Dead Cells

AVISO: dispositivos com menos de 2 GB de RAM podem não conseguir rodar este conteúdo corretamente. Recomendamos não ficar com este DLC se o dispositivo estiver com menos de 2 GB de RAM.

Recriado cuidadosamente para dispositivos móveis com uma interface renovada
• Dois modos de jogo disponíveis: Original e Autoataque

• Controles personalizados e mais opções de controles de toque disponíveis: Troque a posição e o tamanho dos botões como preferir, deslize para esquivar...

• Suporte para controle externo MFi

•  Sem anúncios, sem mecânicas F2P!

Se encontrar um problema, entre em contato conosco pelo e-mail support@playdigious.mail.helpshift.com e forneça o máximo de informação possível sobre o problema.
